title: DSL-Bench: Evaluating and Explaining LLM Code Generation Across Domain-Specific Languages
title_zh: DSL-Bench：跨领域特定语言评估与解释大语言模型代码生成

paragraphs.en: 提出跨DSL代码生成基准DSL-Bench，揭示LLM语义正确性远低于语法通过率。 Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software-engineering workflows, but code-generation benchmarks largely focus on general-purpose languages. Domain-specific languages (DSLs) have distinct syntax, semantics, and validation requirements, making results from individual DSL benchmarks difficult to compare. We present DSL-Bench, an executable benchmark and analysis framework for cross-DSL code generation. Starting from 13,045 DSL-related papers, LLM-assisted open card sorting identifies 18 representative application domains. For each domain, we select an evaluable DSL and provide a syntax checker and task-level semantic oracle. Evaluating 7 LLMs on 18 DSLs, we observe mean syntax and semantic pass rates of 31.37% and 11.64%, respectively, revealing a substantial gap between syntax acceptance and semantic correctness. A variance decomposition attributes 76.99% of semantic pass-rate variation to differences among DSLs and 7.86% to differences among models. Among four DSL-level factors, Knowledge Demand has the strongest negative association with semantic correctness (r = -0.508). We evaluate prompt engineering across all 18 DSLs and study five improvement methods on five targeted DSLs. Prompt engineering yields uneven gains; RAG-Refinement, the strongest targeted method, improves semantic correctness by 16.29 percentage points on average over matched baselines. We further derive capability profiles and DSL-Profiler summaries for interpreting data-scarce DSLs. These results highlight toolchain-specific semantic bottlenecks and the need to evaluate DSL code generation beyond syntax acceptance.
paragraphs.zh: 提出跨DSL代码生成基准DSL-Bench，揭示LLM语义正确性远低于语法通过率。大语言模型（LLM）在软件工程工作流中的应用日益广泛，但代码生成基准大多聚焦于通用编程语言。 领域特定语言（DSL）具有独特的语法、语义和验证要求，使得单个DSL基准的结果难以相互比较。 我们提出DSL-Bench，一个面向跨DSL代码生成的可执行基准与分析框架。 从13,045篇DSL相关论文出发，借助LLM辅助的开放式卡片分类法识别出18个代表性应用领域。 针对每个领域，我们选定一个可评估的DSL，并提供语法检查器和任务级语义判定器。 在18个DSL上评估7个LLM，我们观察到平均语法通过率和语义通过率分别为31.37%和11.64%，揭示了语法接受与语义正确性之间的巨大差距。 方差分解显示，语义通过率变异的76.99%归因于DSL之间的差异，7.86%归因于模型之间的差异。 在四个DSL层面因素中，知识需求与语义正确性的负相关最强（r = -0.508）。 我们在全部18个DSL上评估了提示工程，并在五个目标DSL上研究了五种改进方法。 提示工程带来的提升不均衡；其中最强的针对性方法RAG-Refinement，在匹配基线上平均将语义正确性提升16.29个百分点。 我们进一步导出能力画像和DSL-Profiler摘要，用于解读数据稀缺的DSL。 这些结果凸显了特定工具链的语义瓶颈，以及超越语法接受来评估DSL代码生成的必要性。
